## Pull Request Description

### Summary of Changes
Provide a concise overview of what this PR introduces or fixes.

### Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 💄 UI / Design System update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring / Code quality improvement
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update

### Checklist
- [ ] Code builds without errors (`npm --prefix frontend run build`)
- [ ] Code follows project styling guidelines and `.prettierrc`
- [ ] All new components or features include proper TypeScript types
- [ ] Tested on Chrome, Firefox, and mobile viewport sizes
